items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 September 2026 5:22pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 09 September 2026 at 5:20pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the southwest of the British Isles, extending a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

Westerly 2 to 4, but Variable in places, becoming South or Southwest 4 or 5 this evening, then increasing 5 or 6 occasionally 7 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming moderate tomorrow morning, occasionally rough later.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle spread from the west tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 5 or 6, veering Westerly 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, then decreasing 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, falling slight overnight into Friday.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle in the east at first, otherwise fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
